Verses.22:
Samuel said,
"Does the LORD delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices
	as much as obeying the voice of the LORD?
To obey is better than sacrifice,
	and to pay attention is better than the fat of rams.
Verses.23:
For rebellion is like the sin of divination,
	and stubbornness like the evil of idolatry.
Since you have rejected the word of the LORD,
	He has also rejected you as king."

Changes: 2025-02-04 - Paul Prins: Initial translation of verses 22-23.
